bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears, coming off their bye week at 7-2, are preparing to host the New Orleans Saints on Sunday, with head coach Ben Johnson confirming that wide receiver Luther Burden is out of concussion protocol ahead of the matchup . Meanwhile, the Bears received a roster boost as running back Kyle Monangai showed strong signs of returning, while cornerback Kyler Gordon's status remains uncertain due to a shoulder injury suffered back in Week 9 against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions confirmed that star edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson is out for the season with what tests showed to be a torn ACL in his right knee, with sources telling NFL Network's Ian Rapoport there could be additional meniscus damage from the injury suffered while celebrating a sack in Munich. Amid the mounting injuries, head coach Dan Campbell said he plans to get safety Kerby Joseph going in Week 11 against Tampa Bay , which would mark Joseph's season debut after starting on the reserve/PUP list with a knee injury.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers (5-3) are using their mini-bye week to regroup after announcing roster moves, including signing WR Coleman Owen and DT Haggai Ndubuisi to the practice squad , while also releasing K Lenny Krieg from the roster. Meanwhile, head coach Matt LaFleur offered an encouraging update on Micah Parsons potentially being ready to make his season debut following the Packers' Week 11 bye, though he still has "a couple more hurdles" to clear before returning from his knee/illness issue.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest story centers on Kirk Cousins' emotional return to Minnesota, as he led the Vikings to a 30-10 victory over the Green Bay Packers in his first game since being reacquired at the trade deadline, completing 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns . Adding to the good news, Justin Jefferson noted the Vikings' dominant defense sacked Packers quarterback Jordan Love eight times and forced four turnovers , fueling renewed optimism about Minnesota's Super Bowl hopes.
